# QuietFollow disposable product history

`quietfollow-pilot.bundle` is a local synthetic Git bundle created for the Module 6 pilot. It preserves only the explicitly selected branches and tags for the A/B/C/D/M delivery sequence; it is not a source repository, release, or external publication.

The bundle contains `main`, `case/e12-b`, `case/e14-d`, and tags `pilot-A` through `pilot-D` plus `pilot-M`. `bundle.sha256` binds the exact tracked bundle bytes.
